GameAfterTrigger.description: Once, some time after the scene is shown.

after.description: Milliseconds after the scene is shown: a number, or an expression.

GameAnimationEndTrigger.description: A CSS animation ending on an element of the scene.

GameAnswerAction.description: Submits an answer to this scene's challenge, checked as a typed answer is. Challenge scenes only.

delayMs.description: Milliseconds to wait before it happens. Defaults to 0. Later actions don't wait for it.

GameChallengeData.description: Describes an individual challenge in the game

id.description: Unique id for this challenge, used when submitting and checking answers.

scenes.description: Scenes for this challenge, chosen by purpose: title, in progress, and completed.

solution.description: How the player's answer is checked for this challenge.

GameChallengeScene.description: A scene for one stage of a challenge's lifecycle.

avatar.description: What stands in for the player in this scene, over broader scenes' settings.

resetScene.description: Shown in this scene's place first, to help the player get ready for it, until one of its rules finishes it.

scene.description: How this scene is laid out, over broader scenes' setting.

GameChallengeScenePurpose.description: What a challenge scene is for: its title, while in progress, or once completed.

GameChallengeSolution.description: Information about how to respond to a user's game challenge answer

answers.description: One or more valid solutions for this challenge

ignoreCase.description: Solutions can be matched ignoring case, default: true

ignoreWhitespace.description: Solutions can be matched ignoring whitespace, default: true

trimWhitespace.description: Solutions can be matched ignoring leading and trailing whitespace, default: true

GameCompleteChallengeAction.description: Marks this scene's challenge as solved. Challenge scenes only.

delayMs.description: Milliseconds to wait before it happens. Defaults to 0. Later actions don't wait for it.

GameData.description: A game's authored definition: its overview scenes, stages, challenges, resources and settings.

autoAdvanceStages.description:
Whether to move on to the next stage automatically on completion.
Not yet implemented: never read. See docs/prompts/000.00.02.feedback - fixes from identified bugs and tests.md #3.

sequential.description: If true (the default when `config` is omitted), each stage unlocks only after the previous one is completed.

credits.description: Credits for the third-party media this game uses, listed with the game on the landing page.

text.description: What to show, e.g. the work's title and author.

url.description: Where to link the text to, if anywhere.

description.description: One-line description, shown on the game's tile on the landing page.

gameContainerStyle.description: CSS applied to the element containing the whole game, e.g. fonts, colours and sizing.

resources.description: Named media resources, referenced by `*Resource` keys and passed to templates as `resources`.

reward.description: The celebration shown when a stage is completed. Unset means none.

scenes.description: Overview scenes (title, stages, complete), shown when no stage is active.

sounds.description: Music and sound effects, as resource names (keys of `resources`). Any left unset is silent.

closingMusicResource.description: Music played on the game-complete overview.

openingMusicResource.description: Music played when the stages overview shows.

stageCompletedSoundResource.description: Sound effect played when a stage is completed.

stageOpenedSoundResource.description: Sound effect played when a stage opens.

stages.description: The stages of the game, in order.

stylesheets.description:
Names of resources (keys of `resources`) that are CSS stylesheets the game needs, such as a web font;
loaded while the game is shown. Only `https:` or same-site URLs are used.

tileGraphic.description: Resource name (a key of `resources`) of the image shown behind the game's landing-page tile.

title.description: Name of the game, shown to players when choosing a game.

GameEffectAngle.description: The range of directions a player spinning away may leave in.

min.description: Degrees on screen: 0 is straight up, 90 is right, and -90 is left.

GameEffectEndTrigger.description: An effect finishing. Not when ended early by `stop`, or by its scene closing or resetting.

target.description: CSS selector: only fire for these elements. Item effects only. Defaults to any element.

GameEffectPosition.description: Where an element goes; see the coordinate system in `docs/special-effects.md`.

GameEnterStageAction.description: Opens a stage, unless it is locked or completed.

delayMs.description: Milliseconds to wait before it happens. Defaults to 0. Later actions don't wait for it.

GameEveryTrigger.description: Repeatedly, while the scene is shown.

every.description: Milliseconds between firings: a number, or an expression re-evaluated each time.

GameFinishResetAction.description: Finishes this reset scene, revealing the scene it is shown for. Reset scenes only.

delayMs.description: Milliseconds to wait before it happens. Defaults to 0. Later actions don't wait for it.

GameHighlightEffect.description: Plays a series of styles on elements, which then return to their own styles.

delayMs.description: Milliseconds to wait before it happens. Defaults to 0. Later actions don't wait for it.

target.description: CSS selector for the elements. Defaults to every item in the shown scenes.

durationMs.description: How long the step takes. Defaults to 1000.

easing.description: A CSS easing function: how the step's styles build. Without one, they apply at full strength throughout.

GameInteractTrigger.description: A player (or a click) interacting with an element of the scene.

holdMs.description:
Entering interactions only (`mouse-enter` and the camera's `-enter`s): fire once the player has stayed over the
element this many milliseconds, rather than as they arrive.

includeCovered.description: Camera interactions only: also fire when the element is covered by another element. Defaults to false.

interact.description: The interactions that fire the rule.

target.description:
CSS selector for the elements, eg. `#door` or `.lava`. May be left out for `jump` alone, which then fires on every
landing; every other interaction needs it, as checked when the game loads.

threshold.description: Camera interactions only: the fraction of the body part that must be inside the element (0–1). Defaults to 1.

within.description:
`near-enter` and `near-exit` only, which need it: how close counts as near. The distance from the centre of the
element to the closest part of the player's silhouette, as a % of the scene's width.

GameItemFallEffect.description: Drops elements off the bottom of the scene, where they stay until it resets.

cycleMs.description: The length of one loop, when `durationMs` is `"indefinite"`.

delayMs.description: Milliseconds to wait before it happens. Defaults to 0. Later actions don't wait for it.

easing.description: A CSS easing function: how it speeds up and slows down.

target.description: CSS selector for the elements. Defaults to every item in the shown scenes.

GameItemMoveEffect.description: Moves elements, where they stay until their scene resets.

cycleMs.description: The length of one loop, when `durationMs` is `"indefinite"`.

delayMs.description: Milliseconds to wait before it happens. Defaults to 0. Later actions don't wait for it.

easing.description: A CSS easing function: how it speeds up and slows down.

start.description: Where the move begins. Defaults to where the element is now.

target.description: CSS selector for the elements. Defaults to every item in the shown scenes.

GameModulesData.description: Game-wide settings, which any scene can override.

avatar.description: What stands in for the player, unless a scene says otherwise. Defaults to `mouse`.

scene.description: How scenes are laid out, unless a scene says otherwise. Defaults to `2D`.

GameOverviewScene.description: A scene shown when no stage is active.

avatar.description: What stands in for the player in this scene, over broader scenes' settings.

resetScene.description: Shown in this scene's place first, to help the player get ready for it, until one of its rules finishes it.

scene.description: How this scene is laid out, over broader scenes' setting.

GameOverviewScenePurpose.description: What an overview scene is for: the title screen, the stage selection, or the game-complete screen.

GamePlayerFallEffect.description: Drops players off the scene. They are removed once they have gone.

delayMs.description: Milliseconds to wait before it happens. Defaults to 0. Later actions don't wait for it.

easing.description: A CSS easing function: how it speeds up and slows down.

players.description: Who it applies to. Defaults to `"triggering"`.

GamePlayerFreezeEffect.description: Stops players in place until `player-unfreeze`. They are still active, but can't interact. Applies at once.

delayMs.description: Milliseconds to wait before it happens. Defaults to 0. Later actions don't wait for it.

players.description: Who it applies to. Defaults to `"triggering"`.

GamePlayerOpacityEffect.description: Hides players, or shows them again. They are still active, and can still interact.

delayMs.description: Milliseconds to wait before it happens. Defaults to 0. Later actions don't wait for it.

easing.description: A CSS easing function: how it speeds up and slows down.

players.description: Who it applies to. Defaults to `"triggering"`.

GamePlayerRestoreEffect.description: Returns players to normal, whatever has happened to them. `"all"` includes removed players.

delayMs.description: Milliseconds to wait before it happens. Defaults to 0. Later actions don't wait for it.

durationMs.description: How long they take to fade back in. Defaults to 500.

players.description: Who it applies to. Defaults to `"triggering"`.

GamePlayerSpinAwayEffect.description: Knocks players off the scene, turning as they go. They are removed once they have gone.

angle.description: The directions they may leave in; one is picked at random. Defaults to -60 to 60.

delayMs.description: Milliseconds to wait before it happens. Defaults to 0. Later actions don't wait for it.

easing.description: A CSS easing function: how it speeds up and slows down.

opacity.description: How opaque they are by the time they are off-screen. Defaults to 1.

players.description: Who it applies to. Defaults to `"triggering"`.

rotations.description: How many times they turn on the way. The direction is random. Defaults to 2.

zoom.description: How much bigger or smaller they are by the time they are off-screen, as a multiple above 0. Defaults to 1.

GamePlayerStaticEffect.description: Makes players look partly transparent, like a detuned TV. They are still active, and can still interact.

delayMs.description: Milliseconds to wait before it happens. Defaults to 0. Later actions don't wait for it.

easeMs.description: How long it takes to reach `proportion`, and to fade away again. Defaults to 500.

easing.description: A CSS easing function: how it speeds up and slows down.

pixelSize.description: The size of each block of static, as a % of the scene's width, above 0. Defaults to 0.5.

players.description: Who it applies to. Defaults to `"triggering"`.

proportion.description: The target proportion of the player's pixels made transparent. Defaults to 0.5.

GamePlayerUnfreezeEffect.description: Returns frozen players to the live camera. Applies at once.

delayMs.description: Milliseconds to wait before it happens. Defaults to 0. Later actions don't wait for it.

players.description: Who it applies to. Defaults to `"triggering"`.

GamePositionByAmount.description: An amount from where the element is when the effect starts.

by.description: The amount, as % of the scene's width and height.

GamePositionFromElement.description: An amount from the centre of another element.

from.description: CSS selector for the other element.

left.description: % of the scene's width, from the left.

top.description: % of the scene's height, from the top.

GamePositionInScene.description: A place in the scene: the element's centre, as % of the scene's width and height.

left.description: % of the scene's width, from the left.

top.description: % of the scene's height, from the top.

GameQuakeEffect.description: Shakes elements. Moves each item, never a layer's container, so items can still sort among players.

consistentMotion.description: Whether all the items shake with the same motion. If false, each item's motion is random. Defaults to true.

cycleMs.description: The length of one loop, when `durationMs` is `"indefinite"`.

delayMs.description: Milliseconds to wait before it happens. Defaults to 0. Later actions don't wait for it.

dx.description: How far to shake horizontally, as a % of the scene's width. Defaults to 0.

dy.description: How far to shake vertically, as a % of the scene's height. Defaults to 0.

easing.description: A CSS easing function: how it speeds up and slows down.

target.description: CSS selector for the elements. Defaults to every item in the shown scenes.

GameResetChallengeAction.description: Clears this scene's challenge, and the state of its scenes. Challenge scenes only.

delayMs.description: Milliseconds to wait before it happens. Defaults to 0. Later actions don't wait for it.

GameResetScene.description: A scene that helps the player get ready for its parent scene, eg. "Return to the start".

avatar.description: What stands in for the player while it shows, over its parent's settings.

component.description: How this scene is rendered, and the rules that finish it (`finishReset`).

resetScene.description: A reset scene for this reset scene, shown before it.

scene.description: How it is laid out, over its parent's setting.

showOn.description:
When it shows: before its parent is first shown since the game loaded (the default), or before every showing.
It always shows again when its parent's challenge is reset. A nested reset scene shows with this one.

delayMs.description: Milliseconds to wait before it happens. Defaults to 0. Later actions don't wait for it.

target.description: The path or URL, interpreted according to `type`.

type.description: `local`: path on this site. `relative`: relative to the repository's location. `url`: absolute URL used as-is.

GameResourceDefinitions.description:
Named resources, keyed by the name used to refer to them.
Resolved to absolute URLs when the game loads.

GameRewardAction.description:
Shows a celebration, as the game does for a completed stage; not shown to players who prefer reduced motion. It
doesn't hold up the rule, and plays alongside any other sounds and rewards.

delayMs.description: Milliseconds to wait before it happens. Defaults to 0. Later actions don't wait for it.

players.description: The players each burst starts from the centre of the body of, instead of `target`.

target.description: CSS selector: each burst starts from the centre of a matching element. Defaults to the middle of the game.

GameRewardData.description: A celebration: a burst of particles over the game.

GameRule.description: One behaviour: when the trigger fires and the condition holds, apply the actions in order.

do.description: What the rule does, in order.

if.description: The rule is skipped when this expression is false.

GameSceneAvatarData.description:
Avatar settings for one scene. `mode` and `fallback` go together: a scene that sets `mode` doesn't inherit a broader
scene's `fallback`. `preview` inherits on its own.

fallback.description: The mode to use when the camera isn't available. Leaving it out of a `camera` mode means the camera is required.

mode.description: What stands in for the player while this scene shows.

preview.description: Whether the webcam preview shows while this scene shows; only in `camera` mode.

GameSceneComponentData.description: The rendering definition of a scene, discriminated by `type`.

GameSceneDialogComponentData.description: A paged scene on a background image of the game's choosing, scaled to fit, with the text kept inside its margins.

backgroundStyle.description: CSS for the background layer's container.

backgroundTemplate.description: Template for the background layer, drawn behind the game's other content.

backgroundTemplateStyle.description: CSS for the element wrapping the rendered background template.

contents.description: The pages, shown one at a time in order.

data.description: Extra values for this scene, passed through to its templates as `data` (and `componentData`).

foregroundStyle.description: CSS for the foreground layer's container: the column the pages are shown in.

foregroundTemplate.description: Template for each page in the foreground layer, drawn in front of the game's other content.

imageMargins.description: Where the text sits on the image. Defaults to no margin.

imageResource.description: Resource name of the background image. Without one, the dialog fills its scene.

initialState.description: The scene's state when it is first shown, and after a reset. Templates and rules see it as `state`.

keepRemovedPlayers.description: Whether players stay removed when this scene resets. Moving to another scene restores them anyway. Defaults to false.

resetStateOnShow.description: Whether state returns to `initialState` each time the scene is shown. Defaults to false.

rules.description: What happens in response to events, in order.

type.description: Which kind of component this is.

GameSceneDialogMargins.description:
Space to leave between each edge of a dialog's image and its text, as CSS percentages of the image's
height (top, bottom) or width (left, right), e.g. `"12%"`. Use it to keep text off transparent or decorative edges.

bottom.description: From the image's bottom edge, as a percentage of its height.

left.description: From the image's left edge, as a percentage of its width.

right.description: From the image's right edge, as a percentage of its width.

top.description: From the image's top edge, as a percentage of its height.

audioDescription.description: Accessible description of the audio, for screen readers. Default: "audio".

motionImageResource.description: Resource name of an image shown while the audio is playing.

resource.description: Resource name of the audio file.

stillImageResource.description: Resource name of an image shown while the audio is not playing.

type.description: The kind of media: only audio is supported.

media.description: Audio to play on this page.

GameSceneTemplateComponentData.description: A scene built from Handlebars templates, drawn as a background layer and a foreground layer.

backgroundStyle.description: CSS for the background layer's container.

backgroundTemplate.description: Template for the background layer, drawn behind the game's other content.

backgroundTemplateStyle.description: CSS for the element wrapping the rendered background template.

GameSceneTemplateSourceData.description: Says where to find a template's text.

content.description: The template text itself. Used only when `sourceType` is `embedded`.

sourceType.description: How `templateSource` is resolved, or `embedded` to use `content`.

templateSource.description: Path or URL of the template, interpreted according to `sourceType`. Unused for `embedded`.

GameSetAction.description: Sets state keys to the values of expressions, all evaluated against the state before the action.

sound.description: The resource's name, a key of the game's `resources`.

GameStageData.description:
Describes a game stage - including its scenes, and the challenges it contains.
A stage may contain more than one challenge, and may group its challenges together.

challengeChunking.description: How many challenges to show together at once in the stage layout. Default: 1.

challenges.description: The challenges in this stage, in the order they are presented.

id.description: Unique id for this stage, referenced by `enterStage` actions in scene rules.

scenes.description: Scenes shown behind this stage's challenges (purpose `shared`). Optional.

GameStageScene.description: A scene shared by all challenges in a stage.

avatar.description: What stands in for the player in this scene, over broader scenes' settings.

resetScene.description: Shown in this scene's place first, to help the player get ready for it, until one of its rules finishes it.

scene.description: How this scene is laid out, over broader scenes' setting.

GameStopEffect.description: Ends effects before their scene does. An item returns to where its template puts it.

delayMs.description: Milliseconds to wait before it happens. Defaults to 0. Later actions don't wait for it.

players.description: The players to stop effects on, instead of `target`.

stop.description: The effect to stop. Defaults to all of them.

target.description: CSS selector for the elements. Defaults to every item in the shown scenes.

GameTransitionEndTrigger.description: A CSS transition ending on an element of the scene.

GameWhenTrigger.description: An expression turning from false to true, or staying true for a while after that.

forMs.description:
Fires once the expression has stayed true this many milliseconds after changing to true, rather than straight
away. Turning false, or the scene being hidden, starts it again.

when.description: Fires on each change from false to true, after any state or game change.

RewardAnimation.description:
The partycles animations a reward can use. Declared here rather than imported from partycles
because the schema generator can't resolve that package; keep in step with its `AnimationType`.

TemplateSourceType.description:
Where a template is read from: `local` (path on this site), `relative` (relative to the repository's location),
`url` (absolute URL, fetched as-is) or `embedded` (text inline in `content`).

description: A collection of games, keyed by id. This is the top level of a game repository JSON file.

error.description: Runtime-only message, set by the provider if loading failed. Not authored.

games.description: The games in this repository, keyed by {@link GameId}.

loading.description: Runtime-only flag, set by the provider while the repository is being fetched. Not authored.

ready.description: Runtime-only flag, set by the provider once loading has succeeded. Not authored.
